description: Dance where you are: with no dance named, one you know ("free" for a free dance); a dance you know by name (everyone here joins in, in time), or with residents who are here (visit first; nobody is walked over). moves lists your dances; (defdance :name [:hop :twirl :pose]) in do makes one.

dance.description: Optional: a dance you know, like pebble-shuffle, or free. Left out, it picks one you know.

key.description: Your Plazmi key, pz_…; only needed when this chat doesn't remember you.

with.description: Optional: a resident's name, to dance with them.

name: dance
